title: ERROR: Couldn't wait for Vulkan fence (VkResult error -4)
body:
### Tested versions

4.7.2 stable
(might test older version later)

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1088) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 61.64 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)
